name: Loom
tagline: Quick screen and video recordings with instant sharing
verdictSummary: Screen capture via MediaRecorder API + upload to S3/R2. Add a sharing link. Done in one sitting. The hard part is the native desktop app with system audio capture.
coreLoopDIY: Browser-based screen recording with cloud upload
whyPeopleStillPay: Teams needing the desktop app with system audio and viewer analytics

priorArt.name: OBS Studio Excellent open-source recording engine; hosting/sharing remains the DIY gap. ↗
priorArt.desc: OBS Studio Excellent open-source recording engine; hosting/sharing remains the DIY gap. ↗

notes: Very doable as a browser app. Native desktop recording is harder.
